name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A modal panel pinned to an edge, on UI SDK's Drawer: the iOS card sheet with a grabber at the bottom, side panels on the left and right, or a drop-down from the top; it follows a drag, rests on snap points and springs away, and a short sheet springs to its content (SheetView), through the views of a flow. `contained` keeps it inside its parent box, and the panel variant is the edge drawer of a sidebar or menu.
